description: Otsuka Pakistan Limited was incorporated in February 1988 and began commercial production of intravenous solutions in September 1989 at its factory in Hub, Balochistan. It manufactures, markets and distributes IV infusions — electrolyte solutions, carbohydrate solutions and clinical nutrition products — and trades in pharmaceutical products, nutritional foods and medical equipment. The company is an indirect subsidiary of Otsuka Pharmaceutical Company Limited of Japan.
